nom: Aveeno Daily Moisturizing Body Lotion for Normal to Dry Skin

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the lotion turning cracked, tight, or flaky skin soft and hydrated within a day or two of regular use, with several calling it the most effective option they've tried for winter dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several using it on the face and one whose eczema-prone child has used it for years, report it doesn't burn, irritate, or trigger breakouts, crediting the fragrance-free formula.

concerns.dehydration: This is the concern reviewers describe most: cracked, painful, or persistently dry skin recovering noticeably within a day or two, with hydration reported to last well into the next day for several reviewers.
concerns.redness: Reviewers prone to burning or redness on very dry skin report the lotion keeps problem areas calm without causing any burning, and a couple describe it calming general dryness-related irritation as well.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema-prone skin, including a child using it for years, report it doesn't trigger flare-ups and keeps the skin barrier comfortable, though these accounts describe tolerance rather than a treatment effect.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers who use the body lotion on their face report no breakouts, though this is a body lotion and facial use is mentioned only occasionally.

aspects.libelle: Pump can leak or trap product at the bottle's bottom
Rich, fast-absorbing texture with no greasy residue
Virtually no fragrance, just a faint oatmeal scent
Large bottle offers strong value for the price
Travel gift set sometimes arrives missing an item
Travel-size flip-cap version feels thinner than the pump bottle

extraits.texte: This is a review for "Aveeno Daily Travel Essentials Gift Set with Daily Moisturizing Lotion, Daily Moisturizing Body Wash, Calm + Restore Makeup Removing Wipes, & Calm + Restore Oat Gel Moisturizer, 4 items" ❌️ - My package only had three items in it. I guess it must have missed a stop in the assembly line. I did not receive the body wash. This review is based off the three items I did receive. I removed one star for the body wash missing. Makeup Removing Wipes ✅️ - Effective at dissolving/removing makeup ✅️ - Size of wipe is big enough to cover your hand for cleansing your face. Not too small, not too large. ► - Wipes are a little on the dry side. I feel the need to use one for each side of my face, since the wipes are not very "wet" feeling. I don't want to have to tug at my skin. I removed one star for this. Maybe as I get farther into the package, the moisture content will improve and it is only the ones on the top f the stack that are dryish? Body Lotion ✅️ - Leaves my skin feeling very hydrated - petrolatum is a great occlusive and is the fourth ingredient in the list ✅️ - Spreads well over skin - glycerin is second ingredient ✅️ - Unscented ✅️ - 2.5 oz tube is surprisingly more lotion than I would expect. extraits.texte: Almost 500 reviews for a moisturizing lotion !!!! Sure as hell it means its one of the best !!! And add to that the brand name Aveeno, a trusted and tried brand for the cosmetic products !! I agree with all the reviewers and buyers who had use this product. A couple of years back, I got a small tube of Aveeno moisturizing lotion and I liked it a lot. Stumbled upon tis on Amazon while I was searching for some other products. At a price of $8 for 18 ounces, it was a steal and free shipping inyculded, I didn't wanted to miss it. The item arrived within two days. I have a very dry skin and the best thing I like about Aveeno moisturizer is that I have to use it only once during the day and it keeps my hand moisturized for entire day. Add to it the bonus of being fragrance free !! It is very effective during the dry winter days when you need extra mousture to keep your hands soft and prevent scaling and chapping of skin. Buy it and you wont regret!!!

This lotion is exactly what I needed. My skin gets really cracked and dry after showers or washing my hands, and in the last few weeks it's gotten especially bad (and quite painful at times). I'd heard that this was the best lotion on the market for dry skin, so I decided to pick up a bottle. To say there was a transformation would be an understatement. My skin went from Death Valley to the Amazon rainforest--the lotion really helped moisturize my skin. I use it every time my hands get wet (i.e. after a shower or washing my hands), and as advertised, the lotion is fragrance-free, although it does have a faint scent which may come from the oatmeal used in the product.

First off, I can say my skin is pretty sensitive. I've tried a lot of lotions over the years, and generally, my skin will burn if it's extremely dry. Aveeno does not cause any burning at all. It does a fantastic job of keeping my problem areas moisturized and redness away. The unscented variant doesn't carry any noticeable scent for me, and as a man, I really appreciate that. I use this variant primarily on my face even though it says "body lotion." I find it to be non-greasy, fast aborbing and effective at keeping my skin moisturized for many hours. That said, the dispenser is garbage. Easily leaves a 1/2 cup of the product at the bottom. I transfer it to a small tupperware container with a lid once the pump stops working. That's enough for my little spots for weeks. Still, 5 stars. Aveeno is a wonder product for me.

extraits.titre: Rich, moisturizing lotion, that is fragrance free
extraits.texte: I particularly like the rich moisturizing feel that I get on my skin after using this Aveeno daily moisturizing body lotion. I like that it is not the least bit greasy. It melts into your skin so easily. I like too that it is fragrance free. My husband and my son will not use lotions if there is fragrance in it. They do use this Aveeno. My son has extremely sensitive skin. He has struggled with eczema most of his life. This does not bother his eczema at all. So it is approved by the whole family. I highly recommend this lotion for all your moisturizing needs.

extraits.titre: We've used Aveeno Daily Moisturizing lotion for YEARS
extraits.texte: I have been using Aveeno's Daily Moisturizing lotion for years on my child's eczema prone skin since babyhood, so I was excited to check out the 2-pack lotion. There is a new look to the bottle, but the ingredient list remains the same (please see pics). The consistency is the same, the moisturizing power is still there, and I love that there is no added fragrance. It's very effective at sealing in moisture. I've been using this for 7+ years, will probably be using it for at least 7 more!

I’ve been using this lotion every day and love how soft and hydrated my skin feels. It’s fragrance-free, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly — perfect for sensitive skin. The oat formula really helps calm dryness and irritation. No breakouts, no sticky feeling. Great size and quality.
